name: Turkey Chili
subtitle: With yogurt crema, cheddar, scallions and lime

macros.basis: per 2-cup bowl with crema and cheddar
macros.portion: A 2-cup bowl of chili with about 2 Tbsp yogurt crema and 1 oz cheddar. Chips not included.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: Turkey moved from the freezer to the fridge **the day before**.
Start **~65 min** before you need it.
notes: One 1.7 lb package of turkey per batch makes a meaty chili. No cayenne in the pot, so it stays mild; add hot sauce at the table. Bouillon is salty, so salt goes in at the end.

items: Salt to taste at the end
½ cup Greek yogurt + 1½ tsp lime juice + pinch salt

steps.title: Chop and mix spices
steps.body: Chop **1 onion** and **1 bell pepper**, and mince **3 cloves garlic**, all into one bowl. In a small bowl: **¼ cup chili powder + 2 tsp cumin + 1 tsp oregano**.

steps.title: Brown the turkey
steps.body: Pot over medium-high, **1 tsp olive oil**. Press in **1.7 lb turkey** and leave it **4 min** to brown. While it browns, open the **can of tomatoes**, drain and rinse **2 cans beans**, and make **1 cup broth**. Break up the turkey, cook **3–4 min** more, spoon off fat, and move it to a bowl.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.body: Add the **other 1 tsp olive oil** and the **onion, pepper and garlic**. Cook 6–7 min, scraping up the browned bits.

steps.title: Bloom the spices
steps.body: Return the turkey. Add the **spice bowl + 1½ Tbsp tomato paste** and stir 1–2 min until it darkens and smells toasty.

steps.title: Fill the pot
steps.body: Add the **tomatoes with liquid + 1 cup broth + beans + 1½ cups frozen corn**. Scrape the bottom and bring to a boil.

steps.title: Simmer, and make toppings
steps.body: Simmer uncovered 35–40 min, stirring every 10 min. Meanwhile: whisk **½ cup yogurt + 1½ tsp lime juice + pinch salt**, slice **2 scallions**, and cut the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Salt **¼ tsp** at a time, tasting each time (likely ½ tsp total). A squeeze of lime if it tastes flat.

steps.title: Portion
steps.body: Portion into 2-cup containers. Pack toppings separately: crema, cheddar, scallions, lime wedges and chips.

after: Cool in shallow containers before the lids go on; a full pot stays warm for hours.

source.label: Ambitious Kitchen, Seriously the Best Healthy Turkey Chili
